classification.question_topic: Whether others have similar recurring dreams of an uninhabitable upper/third level reached at the end of Mall World dreams

meta.final_emotion: sad; yearning to live in the space (closest to waking)

position.relative_to: upper level / third level above the second level

qualities.raw_description: “always a upper level”… “on the third level, even though I usually stay on the second.” “always uninhabitable… the floor isn't sturdy enough.” “same third floor… same feelings… same level of decay.” “the actual place seems to kinda change every time… sometimes it feels like my best friend's house from when I was 9… sometimes my grandma's old house… sometimes my current house.”

boundaries.description: Upper/third level described as “uninhabitable” because “the floor isn't sturdy enough or something,” yet the dreamer is “up there anyways.”

interactions.description: Dreamer is on the third/upper level (usually stays on the second), aware of being on the third level; experiences yearning to live there and sadness about not being able to because the floors are not sturdy enough.
These third-level dreams “always seem to happen at the end of a night of mall world dreams,” where the dreamer “end[s] up there after.”

extraction.extraction_notes: Only one explicit location (upper/third level) is described; the broader mall-world areas visited earlier are referenced but not detailed. No explicit connection mechanism (stairs/elevator) is mentioned between second and third levels.
